title: Triage review of c42's food chain where both kinds divide (SIEXD) on fresh seed 5: prey and predator condensates form from noise and coexist to t=12000, and predators divide to generation 3, but prey reach only generation 1 (3 persistent splits)
summary: I re-ran the claimed world.py unchanged with the claim's command on new seed 5 (labkit, 128^2, 120 frames to t=12000, --lineage-k 5; rerun/seed5). Sheet: from the smoothed noise field, cyan prey droplets and orange predator droplets form by t=500. Predators engulf prey into rings, and the rings open into arcs and C-shapes that round up into new predator droplets. Both kinds are present at every frame to t=12000. labkit: predators 29 components at the end (mean 28.9), 36 persistent splits, max generation 3, merge/split 0.45; prey 4 components at the end (mean 10.4, max 54), 3 persistent splits, max generation 1, merge/split 0.19. So S, I and predator division replicate, but repeated prey division (claimed generation 2-6) does not on this seed. I did not run the E fork or the predator-free twin.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise over the whole box; prey and predator droplets everywhere by t=500
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=500-12000: discrete prey and predator condensates coexist at bounded size to the end (FACTS: predator 29, prey 4 components at t=12000)

seeds_run.result: S, I pass; predators divide (36 persistent splits, generation 3); prey do not divide repeatedly (3 persistent splits, generation 1), so D for both kinds fails on this seed

verdicts.limitation: Triage on one fresh seed without the E fork or the X twin. Prey reach generation 1 here against 2-6 on the claim's seeds, so the 'both kinds divide' part varies with the seed. The prey count also ends low (4 droplets), close to prey collapse.
